declaredIdentity: Tenant / evidence-redactions / redactionId; preparation/approval IDs are context.RequestId and compare normalized intent before revision. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: A redaction approval must target current exact original/derived preparation and be independent of its preparer unless exact scoped waiver proof authorizes self-approval.
boundaryRationale: Preparation and approval need same-version admission gate; historical preparations/approvals can be read-side facts with selected-command retry lookup. Waiver is a separate owner and must enter as a value proof.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: Tenant / evidence-redactions / redactionId; preparation/approval IDs are context.RequestId and compare normalized intent before revision. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / evidence-redactions / RedactionId, with exact source artifact/content/version. Selected preparations, approvals and other mutations use CommandId.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / evidence-redactions / RedactionId, with exact source artifact/content/version. Selected preparations, approvals and other mutations use CommandId.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: A redaction creates a new derived artifact with a new content identity linked to its original and never alters the original; the original keeps its own retention and access rules.

decides: A redaction yields a new derived artifact with a new content identity linked to its original and never alters the original, which keeps its own retention and access rules. Any Contributor may prepare the derivative, but approval for disclosure requires a Compliance Lead.
